title: Your First Scorecard: The 3 Numbers That Matter
description:
Most owners run on gut feel and last month's bank balance. This is how you build a simple scorecard that tells you the truth early.
https://allthepower.co.uk

You do not need a finance team or a complicated dashboard. You need a handful of numbers that show what is really happening, while you can still do something about it.

This lesson shows you the difference between lagging numbers that only report the past and leading numbers that predict what is coming, the five tests for a number worth tracking, and how to choose your first one, two, three. Every number gets one owner, a target or an honest baseline first, and a spread across the three jobs of the business: getting the work, doing the work, and managing the money. By the end you have a scorecard you can actually run every Monday.

This is a Thrive Business Community exercise. Pick your three numbers and take it to your team.
